lines: Second half is ours. Dig deep. Nothing left at the whistle.
You have earned this. Fortitude. That is the word. Fortitude.
Heads up, chests out. Leave it all out there. Every one of you.
One more push. Show me character. That is all I am asking.
They are tired. We are not. Grind them down. Grind them down.
This is the moment. Believe. Look at each other and believe.
No passengers. Work rate wins this. Work rate and nothing else.
Forty-five minutes. Give me everything. Then give me a bit more.
Pride. That is what this is about now. Play for the badge.
Take the game to them. Be brave on the ball. Not reckless.
Win your battles. Every duel, every yard. That is the game.
We stay together. Togetherness. Nobody drops their head.
Hunger. I want to see hunger. Want it more than they do.
Control what you can control. The rest sorts itself out.
Nobody gave us this. Earn it. Earn every minute of it.
Trust the process. It is working. Keep doing what we practised.
Leave nothing behind. No regrets in that dressing room after.
Composure. Heads clear, feet fast. Composure wins this one.
They will break. Keep knocking. Persistence. Keep knocking.
Look around you. That is your team. Play for each other.
